title: Exact Defect Correlation Functions in Chern-Simons Matter Theories
summary: We study defect correlators in three-dimensional, large-$N$, conformal field theories with slightly broken higher-spin symmetry. Focusing on the quasi-fermionic theory, we bootstrap correlation functions of four defect-changing operators, i.e. of two collinear conformal line defects with boundaries, at arbitrary values of the coupling constant. We can compute an infinite number of such correlators and present a detailed analysis for three typical cases.
